entries.4b91e6341c1c3ade: This business covers the United States and Canada, together with Mexico, which is included because of its geographic proximity, and is overseen by Denso International America, Inc. Denso Manufacturing Michigan, Inc., Denso Manufacturing Tennessee, Inc. and others manufacture components locally. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,012,358 million.
entries.63e64a7a5b0ed9a2: This is a business not included in the reportable segments, covering the business activities of local subsidiaries in South America and other regions. Denso do Brasil Ltda. in Brazil and others manufacture and sell automotive components. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥126,015 million.
entries.8edcb96a8056ae5b: A company that makes automotive parts such as air conditioners, engines and electronic controls, and supplies them to automakers including Toyota Motor.
entries.9003a51f4b70bc7d: This business covers the Netherlands, the United Kingdom, Italy, Spain, Hungary, the Czech Republic and others, and is overseen by Denso International Europe Co., Ltd. Denso Thermal Systems Co., Ltd. (Italy), Denso Manufacturing Hungary Ltd. and others manufacture components locally. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥691,545 million.
entries.dc6b9bd303d9baa4: This is a domestic business. DENSO CORPORATION and its subsidiaries, including Denso Kyushu Co., Ltd., Denso Iwate Co., Ltd., Denso Ten Ltd. and Jeco Co., Ltd., manufacture and sell automotive components and other parts. Because parts produced in Japan are also shipped to overseas affiliates, revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,087,881 million, while intersegment internal revenue was ¥1,316,212 million. It is the largest of the four reportable segments.
